agenda_text:
AGENDA
  AN ADJOURNED MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
  October 1, 2012
  6:00 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  24300 Narbonne Avenue

1. OPENING CEREMONIES

  a. Call Meeting to Order

  b. Flag Salute

  c. Roll Call

2. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Closed Session items or
  subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When
  addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for
  the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has
  been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the
  Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it
  appears on a posted agenda.

  CLOSED SESSION

3. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - Existing Litigation Pursuant to
  Government Code section 54956.9(a) Islamic Center of the South Bay v. City of
  Lomita, et al. United States District Court LA CV12-02418

4. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - Anticipated Litigation Pursuant to
  Government Code section 54956.9(b) Number of potential cases: 1 Letter from Steven
  H. Rosenbaum to City Attorney dated July 24, 2012

5. RECONVENE IN  OPEN  SESSION  AND  ORAL  CLOSED  SESSION
  ANNOUNCEMENT.
 ADJOURNMENT

Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection
immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk’s office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you
should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to
the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
  October 1, 2012

1. OPENING CEREMONIES

  a. Call Meeting to Order

An adjourned meeting of the Lomita City Council was called to order at 6 p.m. on Monday,
October 1, 2012, in the Council Chambers, Lomita City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue.

  b. Flag Salute

Mayor Gazeley led the salute to the flag.

  c. Roll Call

Those responding to roll call by Assistant City Clerk Shumway were COUNCILMEMBERS:
Estrada, Savidan, Traina, and Mayor Gazeley. Councilmember Sanchez did not attend due to
the conflict with the item for discussion. Also present were City Manager Rock, Assistant City
Manager Sugano, and City Attorney Hogin.

2. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

None
  CLOSED SESSION

3. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – Existing Litigation
Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(a)
Islamic Center of the South Bay v. City of Lomita, et al.
United States District Court LA CV12-02418

4. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – Anticipated Litigation
Pursuant to Government Code section 54956.9(b)
Number of potential cases: 1
Letter from Steven H. Rosenbaum to City Attorney dated July 24, 2012

5.  RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION AND ORAL CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT.

The City Council reconvened at 6:38pm. City Attorney Hogin announced that Councilmember
Sanchez did not attend the closed session. City Attorney Hogin announced that the City Council
met in closed session, provided direction to the City Attorney but did not take any reportable
action.

ADJOURNMENT

Meeting adjourned at 6:44p.m.

  Page 1 of 2
 Respectfully submitted,

__________________________________
Lena Shumway, Assistant City Clerk, CMC

  Page 2 of 2
